page: Microsoft Azure M176s_3_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel processors providing 176 dedicated virtual cores. It features an extensive total memory allocation of 2794.0 GB of RAM, which equates to approximately 15.88 GB of system memory per vCPU core. There are no graphics processing units provisioned on this configuration.

Storage architecture for the M176s_3_v3 relies entirely on remote storage, as the instance includes no local storage disks. It is designated as Premium Storage capable, requiring external block storage volumes for system boot and persistent file storage operations. Network interfaces do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured virtual network infrastructure or allocated public IP resources for inbound routing.

From a performance and cost efficiency perspective, the M176s_3_v3 consolidates extreme memory density and high compute capacity within a single system boundary. This footprint reduces overhead compared to managing horizontally distributed clusters for single large memory states. The absence of local scratch disks requires careful architectural planning for network-attached storage latency and throughput. It is specifically suited for memory-intensive workloads, including enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale SAP HANA deployments, massive caching tiers, and memory-bound transactional data processing.
